name: PassMeter
shortDescription: Local password strength analysis with transparent signals and honest limitations.
features: Named, explainable signals (length, variety, repetition, sequences, patterns)
Local-only analysis; hidden input; reports never echo the password
Batch mode for synthetic test inputs
Approximate entropy estimate labelled as such
knownLimitations: Small bundled weak list cannot stand in for breach corpora
Rubric score is a heuristic estimate, not proof of strength
